title: Direct-image retract from a disjoint open component
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $F$ an etale $\Lambda$-module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $(W_j)_{j\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)}$ be a pairwise disjoint open covering of $X$. For every $i$ the sheaf $(f\circ\iota_i)_*\iota_i^*F$ is a retract of $f_*F$, where $\iota_i:W_i\hookrightarrow X$ is the inclusion and the functors are [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. There is no finiteness, Noetherianity, or local-constancy hypothesis.

proof.text: The complement of W_i is the union of the W_j for j unequal to i, hence is open, so W_i is closed. For j:W_i to X, the already proved Etale.isIso_openImmersionLowerShriekToLowerStar_of_isClosed_range identifies extension by zero with direct image. Set H=j^*F and write L for j_! adjoint to j^* and R for j^* adjoint to j_*. The characterization of the comparison under these adjunctions, and their triangle identities, prove L.counit_F followed by R.unit_F equals the comparison at H. Its inverse followed by L.counit_F is therefore a section of R.unit_F. This gives a retract of F onto j_*H. This is the formal version of projection to one factor followed by zero extension in the disjoint product of sections.

Apply f_* to the section and retraction. Functoriality preserves the retract identity. Transport through Etale.lowerStarComp to obtain the displayed composite direct image. The empty-index case is vacuous and the same adjunction identities cover empty pieces.

theorem nonempty_retract_lowerStar_of_disjoint_open_partition
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (n : ℕ) (W : Fin n → X.Opens) (hcover : (⨆ j, W j) = ⊤)
    (hdisjoint : Pairwise (fun j k ↦ Disjoint (W j) (W k)))
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (i : Fin n) :
    Nonempty (Retract
      ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ((W i).ι ≫ f)).obj
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (W i).ι).obj F))
      ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj F))
